design.name: 穷奇
design.brief: Qiongqi (穷奇), one of the Four Fiends of Chinese myth, 'shaped like a tiger with wings', with the 'hedgehog-quill fur' of its Western Mountains description: a powerful winged tiger about 2.6 m long and 1.3 m at the shoulder, rusty orange-and-black tiger stripes, a big blocky head with a fierce snarl and fangs, two large feathered wings (dark brown with cream bands) spread for a gliding pounce, and a crest of stiff quill-like spines along the neck and back that crackles with magenta-violet lightning and glows (weak spot); violet glowing eyes, lightning veins along the wing bones. Apex predator. NOT a griffin: a real tiger body with wings.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a big tiger (quadruped), the body level, the legs straight under the body and planted, front and hind legs separated with a gap of air; both feathered wings spread fully and horizontally to the sides, straight and level; the head level facing straight ahead with the mouth closed; the porcupine-quill crest on its back standing up; the tail extending straight back and slightly upward; the lightning veins painted opaque (no halo); MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding fur, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; the porcupine-quill crest is made of dark brown quills with pale cream tips (NOT magenta, NOT glowing)
design.turnaround_digits: each paw with four separate toes, countable; both wingtips, the quill crest and the whole tail fully inside the frame (the wingspan is widest in the front and back views, keep generous margin).
